Player Safe: Bramble Union Claimrunner a sharp-eyed lieutenant counting bodies so Kett does not have to A sharp-eyed faun claimrunner wears thorn-braided hair, a blue shard charm, bark armor, and too many salvaged medallions for someone who claims not to care about rank. Block1: Bramble Union Claimrunner BRAM-bul YOO-nyun KLAYM-run-er a sharp-eyed lieutenant counting bodies so Kett does not have to The one keeping the ambush organized while it tries to fall apart. Tactical spine of the fight; remove or sway them and the ambush loses its shape. They follow Kett but watch the math. If the cost climbs too high, they will call the retreat before he does. Parley path Capture/mercy branch Evidence that the road conflict is bigger than banditry Coldly competent, hiding worry behind orders. Proof that surrendering buys the camp more seasons than winning ever could.

Block2: Seize leverage before the party proves too dangerous. Win enough bargaining power that the dispossessed camp survives another season. Seize leverage before the party proves too dangerous. Win enough bargaining power that the dispossessed camp survives another season. Runs on borrowed certainty, turning fear into checklists. Pretends rank does not matter while wearing every salvaged medallion that says it does. Loves the camp in the only language they trust, which is logistics. Three of theirs, maybe. All of ours if we stay. You do the math. Kett, we are past the line we agreed on. Take the crate or take the loss. Pick now. They are improvising from grief as much as strategy. Losing people in a fight that the companies will describe as a routine security matter. Clear terms, hostages being protected, and enemies who admit what they are paid to do. Being called a bandit before being...

Block3: They expect threats first and terms never. Concrete protection for the camp lands; pity bounces. Presence 15 after proof of non-enforcement opens a hard bargain. Presence 15 They lower weapons long enough to bargain. Instinct 14 The player spots who is ready to run, who is committed, and who can be moved. A credible exit for their people, not a personal apology, makes them lower the blade.

Block4: They know the road has winners and losers. They are not all equally committed to killing. Keep the defector truth behind play-earned clues; this scene can show fear, hunger, and displaced-worker pressure without naming the whole engine. Named Bramble variants tie to the camp through gear, charms, and loyalty rather than a new corporation. Hates route-owning companies for making displacement sound like upkeep. Turns the ambush into a values choice instead of a faceless combat stop. A spared reclaimer can become a future informant or complication. Barnacle can smell a deal; Garrick can read fear and posture; any PC can offer a non-lethal branch. Other reclaimers watch this NPC to decide whether they are still a people or only a mob. npc_images portrait asset
